## Professional Summary

Full Stack Software Engineer at PT Unicorn, a growing multi-brand company, working in a small product team that ships what the business runs on every day: an omnichannel AI agent that handles customer conversations and bookings across WhatsApp, Instagram, Email and TikTok (about 3,500 bookings and 17,700 messages a month), an HR platform used by 154 employees, and a multi-brand website builder. Works across the whole stack (Next.js, React Native, Node.js, PostgreSQL), close to the people who use the product, and takes features from first conversation to production. Puts language models into production with guardrails, human handoff and measured results. Uses Claude Code daily and verifies every change with tests and production data. Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals.
